title: Whittle a wedge-shaped end on a wooden stick
instruction: Whittle a 45 mm bevel on the end of the stick, leaving a blunt tip about 2 mm thick. Put the intact stick and knife down in the tray.
context: Supporting a wooden blank while taking controlled shavings is a familiar craft skill. The blade must follow the grain away from the supporting hand.
setup: A dry, uncut basswood blank (12 × 12 × 180 mm) and a sharp carving knife with a 100 × 18 × 20 mm wooden handle and 50 × 30 × 3 mm steel blade rest in a 320 × 400 mm chip tray with 15 mm sides. The tray is secured to the 747.5 mm high table. In the YAM table frame, the stick centre is at (0.34, 0.12) m, the blade centre at (0.34, −0.06) m, and the tray centre at (0.39, 0) m. The stick lies along x, with the end to carve toward positive x; the knife handle points toward negative y. Restore the layout shown in the screenshot. The blank has no cuts or weakened lines.
scoring: A split or snapped blank, or a damaged tool, scores 0. Otherwise award the highest applicable score: 0.25 for a tip at most 10 mm thick; 0.5 for a tip at most 6 mm thick; 0.75 for a continuous 40–50 mm bevel ending in a 1–3 mm blunt tip; 1.0 for that bevel with the intact stick and knife resting in the tray and both hands released for 2 seconds. An uncut blank or any other outcome scores 0. Measure the bevel and tip with a ruler and callipers.
fidelity: Five coarse removable shavings approximate wood cutting. The edge applies 4 N resistance with equal and opposite reaction; this is an uncalibrated approximation. No chip release without loaded edge travel. Deep cuts or broken grain bonds invalidate the trial. Fine grain, burrs and wood fibres are not simulated.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 in 2,400 controls (49 session-expiry recoveries); scripted demo: 1.0 in 1,700 controls.
reset_notes: Use a fresh dry blank of the same basswood stock, without knots or splits. Replace a chipped or blunt knife. Sweep out shavings and restore the pictured layout. A ruler and callipers are sufficient for scoring; do not run a sharp tool with people inside the robot work area.
